description.en: The name of the permission. For more information, see [Permission library](~~465474~~).
The ID of the resource share.

title.zh: 为共享单元解除共享权限

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，在`cn-hangzhou`地域的共享单元`rs-6GRmdD3X****`中，解除共享权限`AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to call the API operation to disassociate the `AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch` permission from the `rs-6GRmdD3X****` resource share in the `cn-hangzhou` region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcesharing disassociate-resource-share-permission --resource-share-id rs-6GRmdD3X0000 --permission-name AliyunRSDefaultPermissionVSwitch --region cn-hangzhou
